prompt:
You are sitting in the cockpit looking out at the depths of space, with panels of electronics around you, whirring bleeps and lights, and the sleek, subtle glow of gently used screens. Combine the analog buzz and grit of Alien and Star Wars with sleek modern screen light and the digital-crush character of Asteroids.

Make a targeted edit of IMAGE 9, the new concept at the end of this reference set. Preserve its rich ink-drawn hardware, expressive shapes, warm amber/dim green lights, and tactile structure.

Reference roles: Image 1 is the owner-selected ink/shadow FINISH. Image 2 is the actual Vanguard SHIP AND BLUE-PURPLE SPACE SCENE. Images 3 and 4 supply recessed chunky HARDWARE and function-key tabs. Image 5 supplies surrounding ELECTRONICS and light groups. Image 6 supplies NOSTROMO SCREEN divisions and inverse bars. Image 7 supplies MU/TH/UR raster mono LETTERING. Image 8 supplies strong SCREEN HATCHING and contrast. Image 9 is the EDIT TARGET, not another mood reference.

On the console use this one dark terminal ledger, crisp warm off-white raster letters, a bright inverse HANGAR header, narrow category column and wider value column, tab-shaped category labels and hatched separator rules. Each category and its value stays on ONE line:
SHIP       Vanguard
ENGINE     Default_Engine
SHIELD     Default_Shield
PRIMARY    Lasers
SECONDARY  Missiles
Selection chevrons beside each value. LAUNCH is the single primary action on the equipment. These are all the actual game values. Keep them complete and legible, without adding fake gauges. Ship and nebula must visibly match Image 2.

Edit Image 9: retain its integrated landscape terminal and exciting dark equipment construction, but use the actual Vanguard from Image 2 instead of its invented vessel, with Image 2's blue-purple nebula. Give the actual Vanguard a generous full-silhouette viewing area centered in the open upper half. Lower the entire foreground console enough to expose that view, retaining its structure and screen readability. Remove the diagonal window bars that enclose the open view. The body of the console is attached below the frame, with deep dark gaps and no continuous pale wall. Preserve the rich mechanical character and terminal divisions. Output the complete 16:9 concept.
